0.why: Square.cpp:261 takes getChannels() on this input and Square.cpp:268 reads channel c with getPolyVoltage; Square.cpp:269 clamps the knob-plus-input sum to -4 to 5, so a negative voltage lowers the pitch
Square.cpp:262 sets this output's channel count from the pitch input

comment: The waveform comes from two breakpoint tables of 38 and 24 points resampled into 2048-point lookup tables at Square.cpp:200 to :208; the crossover frequencies 20 and 100 are at Square.cpp:192, and the output is multiplied by 5 at Square.cpp:312. The module runs at four times the sample rate and decimates back (Square.cpp:24).
